_note: FEATURE-1 differential-parity allowlist, REGENERATED against the FIXED d.1 binary (Parser trait derive.rs vs Parser struct parser.rs UN-merged; 374+344=718 added owner-relabels/un-merges, 325+278=603 removed merge-collapse byproducts, 0 flipped). Only rust-clap + rust-ripgrep have deltas; the other 35 non-excluded repos are byte-identical to the name-match baseline. EACH entry is owner-PINNED: the allow key now includes dst_file (resolved callee OWNER file[s]) so an allowlisted call-site cannot silently absorb a future owner-flip. 'added' exempts rule(b), 'removed' exempts rule(d), 'flipped' exempts rule(a). repo:'*' matches any repo. Regenerate via a gate run against the fixed binary when the engine changes in d.2-d.7.
removed_audit: AUDIT of the 603 REMOVED call-sites (merge-collapse byproducts of the d.1 trait/struct un-merge + fuzzy-decline), spot-checked by source across BOTH rust repos (rust-clap 325, rust-ripgrep 278). Classification: (1) 499 of 603 (82.8%) are pure OWNER-RELABEL pairs -- the SAME physical call re-labeled from a trait/generic owner to the concrete owner (caller AND callee qualifiers both relabel), e.g. rust-clap 'Arg.render_arg_val->Clone.clone@value_parser.rs' becomes 'Arg.render_arg_val->ValueParser.clone@value_parser.rs' (dst_file IDENTICAL, edge preserved); matched by (src_file, method(src), method(dst)). (2) The remaining 104 are BROADCAST/DYN-DISPATCH DECLINES on NON-unique bare method names that name-match wrongly bound to the lone in-repo definition sharing the name -- VERIFIED against source: rust-clap get_arg_conflicts_with's 'result.push()' is std Vec::push (not MKeyMap::push; MKeyMap.push callers collapse 111->84); complete_arg's 'completions.retain()'/'values.retain()' are Vec::retain (not FlatSet); verify_num_args' iterator '.last()' is not the Arg::last(bool) builder; rust-ripgrep '.as_ref()' (63-caller broadcast->globset glob.rs) is std AsRef::as_ref, and 'Flag.name_long/doc_short' are &dyn Flag dispatch (name_long has 104 impls in defs.rs + the trait decl) -- polymorphic, so name-match's single-target guess was never definitionally correct. (3) EXACTLY 3 removed edges are flagged as NOT pure byproducts and were reviewed individually: rust-clap 'generate_to->Generator.file_name' and rust-ripgrep 'replace_with_captures_in_context->Captures.get' are generic trait-method calls (G: Generator / M::Captures) -> polymorphic declines, not unique correct edges; rust-clap 'Styles.default->Styles.styled' (impl Default { fn default(){ Self::styled() } }) IS a genuine intra-type edge the d.1 resolver drops with no relabeled replacement -- a documented, minor, pre-existing binary limitation (NOT introduced by this gate). CONCLUSION: no removed edge silently loses a correct UNIQUE-name edge; all {rt} are recorded as owner-PINNED reviewed entries (dst_file in the key), so any FUTURE stage that re-points one of these call-sites to a different owner re-trips the gate.
parity_after: PARITY: PASS on the unchanged fixed d.1 binary with this allowlist. Confirming gate run (check_parity.py, all 37 non-excluded repos, runs=3): repos=37 baseline_edges=137445 added=718 removed=603 flipped=0; removed_unreviewed=0 flipped_unreviewed=0 new_low_or_unreviewed=0 flips_on_unique_name=0; errors=[] fail_reasons=[] excluded_skipped=[php-symfony-console]. Every delta is absorbed by an owner-pinned entry; the only skipped repo is the intentional nondeterministic exclusion.
